papers.title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
papers.abstract_snippet: Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01339-0 Kalinin et al. argue that for self-driving laboratories to achieve autonomy in the physical world, large language model hypothesis generation needs to be complemented by bottom-up optimization translating hypotheses into executable workflows.
papers.reason: Nature Machine Intelligence 观点文章：主张自驱动实验室要实现物理世界自主，需把 LLM 假设生成与自底向上的奖励函数优化、可执行工作流结合起来。其讨论对象是化学/材料实验室的自动化闭环，并没有 VLA 架构、操作策略或机器人学习实验，与视觉-语言-动作研究无实质关联。
